options.description: The note is written as an HTML comment, so it does not show in the rendered Markdown. The agent reads it, and it never appears in the PDF. Recommended: A hidden comment keeps your notes out of the document while still letting the agent read them, which fits your wish to edit easily without affecting the quality of the delivered PDFs.
options.label: Hidden HTML comment (Recommended)

options.description: The note is written as a plain line the agent recognises, which shows in the Markdown and could be mistaken for document text.
options.label: Visible marker line

options.description: Notes go in a file next to the Markdown rather than inside it, so the document itself stays clean but notes are kept apart from the text they refer to.
options.label: Separate notes file

payload.question:
When you edit the cover letter or resume Markdown and want to leave a note for the AI inside the file, how should that note be written?

You said on 2026-11-18: "I need you to align Codex and Claude in terms of features. Then I need you to allow my self to modify and regenerate easily the cover letter and resume."
payload.text: Well, there is two case: Either I re-write the text, or I leave notes. I guess the AI should read the document and maybe use a diff to identify changes
